target_label: Relative Hydrogen Indicator (DAN passive CTN/CETN net ratio)

provenance.source: Gradient Boosting ensemble (tango-horizon-hydration-v1) trained on MSL DAN passive neutron counts (PDS Geosciences MSL-M-DAN-3/4-RDR-V1.0) with MRO CRISM MTRDR (BD1900_2, SINDEX2), Mars Odyssey THEMIS IR (mc23_aeolis_nir, mc23_aeolis_dir), and MRO CTX DTM/DRG (USGS STAC)
datasets: mro_crism_mtrdr (frt000058a3, frt0000b6f1, frt00021c92, frt0000c518, frt0002037a, hrl0000baba, hrl0000d21c, hrl0000d349, hrl0001233b)
provenance.transform: 500 m spatial-block GroupKFold CV: R2=0.364, Spearman=0.582, MAE=0.370 vs baseline 0.486 (n=1567, blocks=36)
provenance.limitations: Predicts near-surface mineral-bound hydrogen indicator (passive thermal/epithermal neutron ratio) in the top ~0.5 m, not liquid water or shallow ice. Limited to orbital predictor resolution (CRISM 18-36 m/px, CTX 20 m/px, THEMIS 100 m/px).
